scope: Only artwork used by the current civic build, plus its canonical pose reference.

All four complete characters wholly inside their separate equal cells with generous gutters, same head size, whole shoes visible. True transparent background, no shadow, no new props, no labels, no grid. Do not use large stride or strongly bent raised knees from image 1.
